description:
Morning Anxiety Reset 🌿 Bansuri Therapy to Quiet Worry & Feel Light Before the Day Begins | Episode 3 of Morning Reset

If you wake with a knot in your stomach and a mind already rehearsing everything that could go wrong, you are not behind - you just need a softer first hour.

This gentle Indian flute music is designed to quiet morning worry: slow, consoling breaths of bamboo flute that steady you before the day begins.

Enjoy 1 hour of warm bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a steady tanpura drone, breath-led and unhurried, with no vocals.

🌿 MORNING RESET is our Bansuri Therapy series: calm-morning sessions at 6:30 IST. This is Episode 3.
Episode 1 — Morning Cortisol Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wINy9PW48iw
Episode 2 — Morning Stress Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EP2_VIDEO_ID

▶ Keep the calm going — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for anxious mornings, a slow start, meditation, breathwork, yoga, tea or coffee by the window, journaling, prayer, a calm commute, or settling yourself before a difficult day.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Todi (a deep, inward morning raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Consoling, steady, lightening
Atmosphere: Grey first light turning gold, a quiet room, time in hand
Duration: 1 hour

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as soon as you wake, before the phone. Put a hand on your stomach, breathe out a little longer than you breathe in, and let the long flute notes set the pace. Headphones bring out the breath in the bamboo; soft speakers work well too.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Before the worry starts
6:00 A hand on the chest
12:00 The long breath out
18:00 The knot loosens
24:00 Quieter thoughts
30:00 Steady again
36:00 Light coming in
42:00 Feeling lighter
48:00 Calm to carry
54:00 Ready for the day

⏱ BEST FOR
• Morning anxiety and worry
• A racing start to the day
• Meditation and breathwork
• Yoga and gentle stretching
• Tea or coffee by the window
• Journaling and prayer
• A calm commute
• Settling before a big day
• Reading
• Quiet background calm for the home

If this music helped you start lighter, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
